subject: CAIQ assertion digest + evidence routing for limited runtime sample
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@aurorafin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@aurorafin.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: small-scope evidence ask + runtime sample

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the call yesterday. To keep momentum on our CAIQ review, the Aurora security team asked if you can provide a compact "assertion digest" that maps each CAIQ control we flagged to a single authoritative artifact (or a short example snippet) rather than full-scale bundles up front. The goal is to: 

- Shortlist ~30 priority controls (we'll share the list later today)
- Receive a one-page rationale per control (one paragraph) + a named artifact and owner (SRE / Security)
- For runtime-related controls (telemetry, KV cache isolation, token redaction) we want a 30-second sampling snippet showing the log shape (redacted) and where it lives

Is that something you can deliver this week? If so, please indicate owners and an expected handoff time. We can accept DocuSign for signatures on attestations once we have the digest.

Appreciate it — Jane
Security Engineer
Aurora Financial
(attachment: aurora-priority-controls.xlsx)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: small-scope evidence ask + runtime sample

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear ask. We can do the assertion-digest approach. Quick plan: 

1) Kimberly will author the one-paragraph rationale per control and map each to a single artifact name.
2) Marissa will prepare a compact evidence-manifest and surface the sampling snippet for the telemetry controls.
3) I will own the final review and send the DocuSign bundle for your attestations.

Estimated timeline: draft digest + manifest by Friday EOD (2027-05-14 5pm PT); telemetry snippets live in the manifest (redacted) — if you need earlier access to any specific control, flag it back and we prioritize.

Kimberly / Marissa — please confirm owners below and call out any blockers (access, egress restrictions, legal redaction constraints).

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

> On Thu, May 13, 2027 at 09:12 AM Jane Doe <jane.doe@aurorafin.com> wrote:

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ assertion digest: initial package attached

Thanks Logan / Jane — I'm taking the lead on the control-by-control rationale and the single-artifact mapping. Attached is a working workbook (CAIQ_Assertion_Digest_v1.xlsx) that contains: 

- Sheet 1: Priority control list (Aurora-provided) + our short rationale column (one paragraph each).
- Sheet 2: Artifact reference (filename, owner, retention note) 
- Sheet 3: Sampling plan for runtime controls (where snippets come from and the extraction command)

Notes / open items: 
- For runtime telemetry (controls CCM-05, CCM-12, CCM-18 in your list) I generated a redacted sample snippet (runtime-telemetry-snippet.log) showing token-hash masking and kv-cache access markers. That log snippet is indicative (30s window).
- We need SSO access for Aurora reviewers to the artifacts folder (read-only). I created a Drive folder link in the manifest but can also upload ZIP to your secure portal if preferred.
- Legal asked us to avoid including full token values in any attachment; the snippet uses deterministic masking (UID->uid-xxxxx).

Attachments: CAIQ_Assertion_Digest_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), runtime-telemetry-snippet.log (text), evidence-manifest.pdf (summary)

If that aligns, Marissa and I will finalize the manifest and I will push a cleaned PDF export by Friday midday.

-Kimberly Park
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

--
attachment stubs: CAIQ_Assertion_Digest_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), runtime-telemetry-snippet.log (text/plain), evidence-manifest.pdf (application/pdf)

- Evidence manifest exported and uploaded to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example (read-only). The PDF includes the link to each artifact and the named owner.
- DocuSign: I created an embedded signing envelope for the 30 assertions that require attestation; link below. Please confirm the signatory name(s) and we will route.
- Timeline: final cleaned digest + all three attachments (PDF manifest, XLSX digest, redacted log) delivered by Friday 11:00 AM PT if no additional redaction is requested.

DocuSign envelope (preview): https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/exampleId
